\section{Profile}
PhD researcher with a strong commitment to excellence in teaching, holding a Postgraduate Certificate in Academic Practice from the University of Edinburgh. Three years of university teaching experience delivering 120+ tutorial sessions to 400+ students in corporate finance, supervising 20+ MSc dissertations with 5 awarded Distinction. Research expertise in corporate governance and quantitative methods (machine learning, survival analysis, panel econometrics). Published in the \textit{International Journal of Finance \& Economics}. Over five years of professional experience at the People's Bank of China, bringing real-world insights to the classroom.
